variables.name: color/bg/brand
variables.description: Persistent dark brand surface for app headers and navigation; pair with on-brand foregrounds.

variables.name: color/bg/default
variables.description: Base application canvas for pages, workspaces and full-screen layouts.

variables.name: color/bg/elevated
variables.description: Raised surfaces such as cards, menus, popovers and input interiors.

variables.name: color/bg/elevated/opacity-0
variables.description: Transparent endpoint for elevated-surface fades and retained migration treatments.

variables.name: color/bg/elevated/opacity-10
variables.description: 10% elevated-surface tint for skeleton shimmer and subtle surface highlights.

variables.name: color/bg/inverse
variables.description: High-contrast inverse surface, especially tooltips; pair with inverse text and icons.

variables.name: color/bg/inverse/opacity-0
variables.description: Transparent endpoint for inverse-surface gradient and fade treatments.

variables.name: color/bg/inverse/opacity-10
variables.description: 10% inverse tint for subtle shimmer or overlay treatments.

variables.name: color/bg/inverse/opacity-8
variables.description: 8% inverse tint for subdued skeleton bases and low-emphasis overlays.

variables.name: color/bg/overlay
variables.description: Modal backdrop base. Apply the documented 64% layer opacity to dim underlying content.

variables.name: color/bg/overlay-light
variables.description: 60% white wash over content for light loading or masking treatments.

variables.name: color/bg/scrim
variables.description: 60% dark scrim behind modal content or other blocking overlays.

variables.name: color/bg/subtle
variables.description: Quiet surface for secondary panels, grouped content and low-emphasis states.

variables.name: color/bg/transparent
variables.description: No visible fill for ghost controls and surfaces that must show the content beneath.

variables.name: color/border/default
variables.description: Decorative outlines and separators for cards, rows, menus and ordinary surfaces.

variables.name: color/border/focus
variables.description: 50% blue keyboard-focus indicator around interactive controls.

variables.name: color/border/focus-danger
variables.description: 50% red keyboard-focus indicator for destructive actions.

variables.name: color/border/strong
variables.description: Visible boundaries for inputs and controls where users must identify the interactive area.

variables.name: color/border/subtle
variables.description: Very quiet dividers between related content; not the sole boundary of an essential control.

variables.name: color/brand/dds
variables.description: Primary DDS teal in approved brand artwork; keep separate from interactive state colours.

variables.name: color/brand/dds-mark
variables.description: DDS mark accent preserved from the approved logo artwork.

variables.name: color/brand/dds-secondary
variables.description: Secondary DDS teal used in existing brand artwork and logo variants.

variables.name: color/brand/ink
variables.description: Dark ink detail in approved brand artwork; not a substitute for theme-aware body text.

variables.name: color/brand/savannah
variables.description: Savannah product identity accent in approved product branding.

variables.name: color/brand/white
variables.description: Fixed white detail in approved brand artwork and reversed logo variants.

variables.name: color/chart/axis
variables.description: Axes, tick marks and the baseline that establish a chart's coordinate system.

variables.name: color/chart/categorical/01
variables.description: Categorical series 1 (blue) for unordered categories. Keep assignments stable and pair with labels, markers or patterns.

variables.name: color/chart/categorical/02
variables.description: Categorical series 2 (teal) for unordered categories. Keep assignments stable and pair with labels, markers or patterns.

variables.name: color/chart/categorical/03
variables.description: Categorical series 3 (amber) for unordered categories. Keep assignments stable and pair with labels, markers or patterns.

variables.name: color/chart/categorical/04
variables.description: Categorical series 4 (green) for unordered categories. Keep assignments stable and pair with labels, markers or patterns.

variables.name: color/chart/categorical/05
variables.description: Categorical series 5 (violet) for unordered categories. Keep assignments stable and pair with labels, markers or patterns.

variables.name: color/chart/categorical/06
variables.description: Categorical series 6 (rose) for unordered categories. Keep assignments stable and pair with labels, markers or patterns.

variables.name: color/chart/diverging/high
variables.description: Values above the reference midpoint. Use only when the reference has a clear meaning in the data.

variables.name: color/chart/diverging/high-strong
variables.description: Values far above the reference midpoint. Use only when the reference has a clear meaning in the data.

variables.name: color/chart/diverging/low
variables.description: Values below the reference midpoint. Use only when the reference has a clear meaning in the data.

variables.name: color/chart/diverging/low-strong
variables.description: Values far below the reference midpoint. Use only when the reference has a clear meaning in the data.

variables.name: color/chart/diverging/midpoint
variables.description: Neutral reference midpoint, such as zero variance or a target. Use only when the reference has a clear meaning in the data.

variables.name: color/chart/grid
variables.description: Quiet chart grid lines and heatmap boundaries that support comparison without dominating the data.

variables.name: color/chart/label
variables.description: Axis labels, legends, category names and direct labels outside coloured chart marks.

variables.name: color/chart/reference
variables.description: Target, benchmark or comparison lines; label what the reference represents.

variables.name: color/chart/sequential/01
variables.description: Ordered magnitude step 1 of 5, from lowest (01) to highest (05), for intensity maps and quantitative heatmaps.

variables.name: color/chart/sequential/02
variables.description: Ordered magnitude step 2 of 5, from lowest (01) to highest (05), for intensity maps and quantitative heatmaps.

variables.name: color/chart/sequential/03
variables.description: Ordered magnitude step 3 of 5, from lowest (01) to highest (05), for intensity maps and quantitative heatmaps.

variables.name: color/chart/sequential/04
variables.description: Ordered magnitude step 4 of 5, from lowest (01) to highest (05), for intensity maps and quantitative heatmaps.

variables.name: color/chart/sequential/05
variables.description: Ordered magnitude step 5 of 5, from lowest (01) to highest (05), for intensity maps and quantitative heatmaps.

variables.name: color/chart/status/negative
variables.description: Data with an explicit negative or failed status; pair with a clear text label.

variables.name: color/chart/status/positive
variables.description: Data with an explicit positive or successful status; do not assign to arbitrary categories.

variables.name: color/chart/status/warning
variables.description: Data with an explicit pending, caution or at-risk status.

variables.name: color/chart/track
variables.description: Empty or remaining portion of a gauge or progress track.

variables.name: color/effect/shadow
variables.description: 8% black shadow colour for subtle elevation. Apply through a shared shadow style.

variables.name: color/effect/shadow/opacity-8
variables.description: Explicit 8% shadow alias retained by migrated elevation effects.

variables.name: color/effect/text-shadow
variables.description: 65% black text-shadow colour for the established text-shadow effect.

variables.name: color/feedback/error
variables.description: Strong error foreground or fill for failures, invalid input or destructive outcomes; pair it with the appropriate surface or on-feedback text.

variables.name: color/feedback/error-subtle
variables.description: Subtle error surface for failures, invalid input or destructive outcomes; pair with color/feedback/error.

variables.name: color/feedback/info
variables.description: Strong info foreground or fill for neutral information and helpful system updates; pair it with the appropriate surface or on-feedback text.

variables.name: color/feedback/info-subtle
variables.description: Subtle info surface for neutral information and helpful system updates; pair with color/feedback/info.

variables.name: color/feedback/success
variables.description: Strong success foreground or fill for completed or successful outcomes; pair it with the appropriate surface or on-feedback text.

variables.name: color/feedback/success-subtle
variables.description: Subtle success surface for completed or successful outcomes; pair with color/feedback/success.

variables.name: color/feedback/warning
variables.description: Strong warning foreground or fill for pending, caution or at-risk conditions; pair it with the appropriate surface or on-feedback text.

variables.name: color/feedback/warning-subtle
variables.description: Subtle warning surface for pending, caution or at-risk conditions; pair with color/feedback/warning.

variables.name: color/icon/default
variables.description: Primary UI icons on ordinary surfaces, including navigation, actions and status affordances.

variables.name: color/icon/inverse
variables.description: Icon foreground on a theme-inverse surface; pair with color/bg/inverse.

variables.name: color/icon/muted
variables.description: Lower-emphasis icons for secondary actions and supporting information.

variables.name: color/icon/on-brand
variables.description: White navigation and utility icons on a persistent dark brand surface.

variables.name: color/interactive/danger-hover
variables.description: Hover fill for destructive actions; pair with the on-feedback foreground.

variables.name: color/interactive/default
variables.description: Default action colour for primary buttons, active links and selected controls.

variables.name: color/interactive/default/opacity-10
variables.description: 10% action-colour tint for layout grid specimens and faint interactive overlays.

variables.name: color/interactive/hover
variables.description: Pointer-hover treatment for interactive elements using the primary action colour.

variables.name: color/interactive/on-brand
variables.description: Selected navigation label or icon on a persistent dark brand bar.

variables.name: color/interactive/pressed
variables.description: Pressed or actively engaged state of primary interactive elements.

variables.name: color/text/disabled
variables.description: Text on controls that are unavailable for interaction; never use for essential guidance.

variables.name: color/text/inverse
variables.description: Readable foreground on a theme-inverse surface, such as a tooltip.

variables.name: color/text/muted
variables.description: Tertiary metadata, placeholders and low-emphasis guidance on ordinary surfaces.

variables.name: color/text/on-brand
variables.description: White text on persistent dark brand surfaces, including mobile app headers.

variables.name: color/text/on-feedback
variables.description: Foreground labels on strong success, warning, error or information fills.

variables.name: color/text/on-interactive
variables.description: Control labels on filled interactive surfaces; keep paired with the corresponding action fill.

variables.name: color/text/primary
variables.description: Main reading text: headings, field values, table content and important labels.

variables.name: color/text/secondary
variables.description: Supporting copy, descriptions and secondary metadata with lower emphasis.
